tei:div.tei:p: zhal chems gnad kyi me long bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog ser skor/

zhal chems gnad kyi me long du gdams pa/ e ma ho/ /gnas lugs rig pa kun bzang chos kyi sku/ /lhun grub rig pa 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs/ /'char tshul ma 'gags thugs rje sprul ba'i sku/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su mthar phyin rtogs pas 'dud/ /yang zab rtse mo rdo rje snying po'i don/ /mtha' grol klong yangs dgongs don gsang ba 'di/ /mtha' dril 'ub chub thig le nyag gcig po/ /phyi rabs rnams la gdams pa e ma ho/ /ūoṃ/ rang rig dbang chen dbyings su rdzogs pa'i don/ bla mas mngon bstan rtsal dbang dam tshig ldan/ /'khor 'das sems dang ye shes shan phye la/ /lnga ldan dbyings su lta dgongs la zlos shig /aaḥ rig stong ngo bo ka dag chos zad dang*/ /'khor 'das ming med gsal dag chos sku la/ /gzung 'dzin ye grol cog bzhag chos nyid du/ /nang dbyings khregs chod gdod mar e ma ho/ akṣaṃḥ lhun grub gzhi snang lta stangs gzigs stangs gcun/ /phyi gnad gcun pas nang dbyings chos zad dang*/ /snang bzhi tshad phebs gdod ma'i dbyings su grol/ /lhun grub nang dbyings 'gyur med e ma ho/ aḥ thams cad dbyings gcig rang byung rig pa'i klong*/ /gzhi dang gzhir snang mthar zad gdod ma'i dbyings/ /rang don chos sku 'pho 'gyur med pa la/ /gzhan don gzugs sku gzhi snang rol pa yis/ /thams cad don mdzad phrin las rgyud mi 'chad/ shin tu rnam dag 'bras bu e ma ho/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad dbyer med ngang*/ /rang byung ye shes che ba lnga dang ldan/ /lhun grub rang rdzogs chen po'i don 'di nyid/ /tshe gcig grol ba'i theg mchog e ma ho/ zhal gdams gnad kyi me long gab pa mngon du phyung ba/ sbas pa gsal bar ston pa/ dgongs pa mngon du lta ba/ 'phrul gyi me long*/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa padma las 'brel rtsal/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer gyis/ mthar thug don gyi snying po lnga phyung ste/

phyi rabs la gdams pa/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ dpal sngags kyi srung ma bshan pa srog sgrub nag mos srungs shig /dge'o//// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8) - PAGE 208 -PAGE - 209 -- PAGE 207 -
